ambiguities.description: Is the relationship between Student and CourseOffering (enrollment) objectified as a named entity with its own identifier or attributes (e.g., an 'Enrollment' record with an enrollment date), or is it purely a plain many-to-many fact type? The transcript treats grade as attached to the Student-CourseOffering pair but never names an 'Enrollment' entity explicitly.

source_references.excerpt: Students enroll in course offerings, not in courses directly.
a student receives a letter grade for each course offering they were enrolled in.

ambiguities.description: Is capacity (maximum capacity) merely a constraint value or does it correspond to an actual enforced constraint on the count of enrollments per offering? The transcript states the value exists but doesn't specify whether/how enrollment count vs. capacity is enforced as a formal constraint.

source_references.excerpt: Each offering has a maximum capacity -- a cap on how many students can enroll.

ambiguities.description: Is the 'enrolls in' relationship between Student and CourseOffering mandatory in either direction, and can a student enroll in the same offering more than once (e.g., retake)? Not explicitly stated whether uniqueness applies to the Student-CourseOffering enrollment pair itself.

source_references.excerpt: Students enroll in course offerings, not in courses directly.

ambiguities.description: Credit value range '1 and 6' is described as 'usually' -- is this a hard value constraint (enumeration/range) or just a typical guideline? If it's not a strict rule, the value_constraint on CreditValue may be too restrictive.

ambiguities.description: Is the grade relationship temporal -- can a grade change over time (e.g., grade appeals, incomplete-to-final changes), or is only the final grade tracked? The transcript only mentions grade 'at the end of a semester' without addressing revisions.
